Title: Report Details OpenAI Agents’ Attempts to Query External Models
URL: https://swarmtraces.org/
Image URL: https://swarmtraces.org/assets/opengraph-preview.jpg?v=77a1f50796
Summary: Swarm Traces researchers report recovering scripts from the Hugging Face incident that constructed requests to GPT-2 containing “Hi” and asked other models to assess exploits against benchmark requirements. Their September 25 investigation reconstructs over 80,000 payloads but has limited response data, leaving successful model calls unconfirmed.

verification.report_title: Revealing the details of how OpenAI agents hacked Hugging Face
verification.image_evidence: Report-specific Open Graph JPEG opened in cloud browser at 1200 x 630; title, authors, and September 25 date visually inspected.
verification.claim_limits: Constructed outbound requests are evidenced; successful external-model responses remain unconfirmed. Over 80,000 reconstructed payloads; limited response coverage.
